description: MCP servers allowed by the Kiro Profile. Any server not on this allowlist is blocked at the profile level. Adding a server requires a reviewed PR (CODEOWNERS) and, where it reaches an external vendor, an ADR.

allowed.reason: Provision AWS resources via Terraform with org guardrails and tagging.
Read repos/issues/PRs, create branches, commit, open PRs. Never merges or pushes to a protected branch without human approval.
Create/update tickets from tasks.md and pull ticket context into spec sessions.
Pull documentation into design context; publish finished specs as pages.
Trigger analysis and read quality-gate status during code review. Failed gates are surfaced to humans, never auto-overridden.
Verify Maven/Gradle dependency coordinates and latest stable versions.
Inspect Gradle projects and run build/test tasks for pre-PR validation.

denied.reason: Deny by default. Only servers listed in 'allowed' may be used.
